numerical_scope: Three offline fixtures; board replays the same real-image fixture 18 times per graph. Full 1x84x8400 outputs are finite and bitwise stable within each batch; complete first outputs and any differing outputs are saved by the native probe. Cross-geometry FP16 differences remain. Detection fixture: threshold 0.25, same classes/count, matched IoU>=0.98, score error<=0.02.
limits: 12 ordinary wall-clock samples and 3 diagnostic samples per graph; no long camera run
Common region includes three cores, all permutations, Concat, Upsample and restore branches
Native layer timings and ordinary wall-clock timings use separate frames
Same default OCM policy does not imply unchanged per-value OCM placement
Instruction request bytes are not physical DDR transactions or stall cycles
Shared physical storage is not proof of on-chip retention
No labelled mAP validation; default deployment remains unchanged
transport_observations: Three requested normal reboots closed SSH; all recovered to distinct new boot identities.
A read-only state probe during the second reboot failed to connect; preserved without workload retry.
reproduction: Retained setup.py, host.py, analyze.py, receipt.py, full output archives and source-build manifest. Maintained analyze_npu.py, trace_memory_flow.py and check_view_aliases.py verify timing semantics, deployment storage and zero-instruction views. No raw address patching.
